units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:1">Targ. Cant. II, 1</cite> sq. (h. text <cite ref="U00576"><he>שושנה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 27:24">Targ. Ez. XXVII, 24</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="K00405"><he>כּוּשְׁפָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 7:1:4">Y. Shebi. VII, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו לכבוש מן ההן וו׳</he> is it permitted to use roses for preserving in the Sabbatical year?—
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:4">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>ינקותא כלילא דו׳</he> youth is a wreath of roses.
<cite ref="Gittin 68b:22">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>ו׳ חיורא דקאי וכ׳</he> a white rose (or blossom) whose leaves are all on one side.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 6:2">Targ. Cant. VI, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:3">Ib. VII, 3</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 84a:7">B. Bath. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>דחלפא אבי וו׳ דג״ע</he> (Ms. II. … <he>אַוַּו׳</he>) he (the sun) passes the rose-garden of Paradise.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65a">Ab. Zar. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>יתיב</he> … <he>בי וו׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בוורדא</he>) seated up to his neck in roses.

<cite ref="Chullin 46a:12">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>וסימנך כיתונא דוו׳ וכ׳</he> and thy sign-word (for remembering which of the two membranes of the lungs is of vital import) is, the rose-colored (precious) shirt, in which the lungs lie (i.e. the interior membrane).

senses.gloss: עינוניתא דוו׳ the little rose-lobe, name of an additional lobe of the lungs found with animals of the steppes (יְתֵירְתָּא). Ib. 47ᵃ bot.
